title: Preferences
regionNote: Sets which businesses you see, your currency, and the country your withdrawals are paid out to.
regionLockedNote: Your payout account is already set up, so your region can't be changed here. <support>Contact support</support> if you need to change it.
regionSwitchBody: You'll see businesses in {{country}}, your currency will change, and your withdrawals will go to a bank there.
